name: USAT Liberty

sources.title: USAT Liberty — cargo ship of 1918, torpedoed in January 1942, beached at Tulamben, pushed off the beach by the 1963 eruption of Mount Agung; the wreck from about 5 to 30 m
Dive Concepts — USAT Liberty dive site: lying on her right (starboard) flank, 5-28 m, bow to the west, stern to the east; a gun under its mount at the front in 28 m
Alert Diver EU — Cult dive: the USAT Liberty (both guns in place, propeller salvaged, corals and sponges)

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q2468064_usat_liberty.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her starboard side, bow to the west, the middle of the hull broken and collapsed with plating fallen away into the holds, the superstructure crumpled; the bow and stern guns still in place; no propeller (salvaged); funnel and masts lying on the sand. The real wreck lies on a slope from about 5 to 30 m; on Offlined's flat seabed she lies at the mean depth. The degree of collapse, the colours and the layout are approximate. model_built.glb: the ship as she sailed in 1942. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
